name: 5-[[[(1R,2S)-2-(4-phenylmethoxyphenyl)cyclopropyl]amino]methyl]-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-amine
summary: Vafidemstat is a dual inhibitor of the enzymes lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1; KDM1A) and monoamine oxidase B (MAO-B) which is under development for the treatment of a variety of medical conditions, including aggression, Alzheimer's disease, borderline personality disorder, multiple sclerosis, acute respiratory disease in COVID-19 infection, and schizophrenia.
